name: Well Shin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Well Shin Technology Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based enterprise that specializes in the development and global distribution of electrical connectivity solutions, with a primary focus on household power cords and related accessories. Their extensive product catalog includes items such as locking cords, AC power cord sets, AC/DC adapter kits, and various AC sockets. The company also supplies essential components like AC plugs and connectors (both standalone and as assemblies), adapters, power strips, AC/DC power chargers, hardware and terminal products, as well as a diverse range of wires and cables including PVC, rubber, halogen-free, and electric vehicle-specific cables. These offerings are marketed under brand names such as Smartbears, PLUGO, and Conntek. In addition to traditional sales channels, the company maintains an online retail presence. Founded in 1986, the firm was originally known as Well Shin Enterprise Co., Ltd. before officially changing its name to Well Shin Technology Co., Ltd. in 2002. Its corporate headquarters are located in Taipei City, Taiwan.
